$room..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('metadata/hostId').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('metadata/phase').val() == 'lobby' && !newData.child('players').exists()) || data.child('metadata/hostId').val() == auth.uid)

phase..validate: newData.val() == 'lobby' || newData.val() == 'countdown' || newData.val() == 'playing' || newData.val() == 'paused' || newData.val() == 'finished' || newData.val() == 'results'

expiresAt..validate: newData.isNumber() && (data.exists() ? newData.val() == data.val() : newData.val() > now && newData.val() <= now + 21660000)

$name..write: auth != null && root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('expiresAt').val() > now && !root.child('rooms').child($room).child('blocked').child(auth.uid).exists() && ((root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('phase').val() == 'lobby' && root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('locked').val() == false && !data.exists() && newData.val() == auth.uid) || (data.val() == auth.uid && (!newData.exists() || newData.val() == auth.uid)))

$uid..write: auth != null && auth.uid == $uid && newData.exists() && root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('expiresAt').val() > now && !root.child('rooms').child($room).child('blocked').child($uid).exists() && (data.exists() || (root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('phase').val() == 'lobby' && root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('locked').val() == false))

run..validate: (root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata/hostId').val() == auth.uid) || (newData.hasChildren(['score','checkpoint','correct','wrong','elapsedMs','gems','finished','progress']) && newData.child('correct').val() + newData.child('wrong').val() == newData.child('checkpoint').val() && newData.child('score').val() <= newData.child('correct').val()*150 + newData.child('gems').val()*10 + (newData.child('finished').val() == true ? 200 : 0) && (newData.child('finished').val() != true || (newData.child('progress').val() == 1 && newData.child('checkpoint').val() == (root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('level').val() == 5 ? 20 : 9))) && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('checkpoint').val() == 0 && newData.child('score').val() == 0) || ((root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('phase').val() == 'countdown' || root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('phase').val() == 'playing') && now >= root.child('rooms').child($room).child('metadata').child('startAt').val() + 3000 && newData.child('checkpoint').val() >= data.child('checkpoint').val() && newData.child('elapsedMs').val() >= data.child('elapsedMs').val()) || newData.val() == data.val()))
